causes.label: Cabinet moving
remedies: Washer is designed to move 1/4″ to reduce forces transmitted to the floor.
This movement is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Cabinet moving"

causes.label: All rubber leveling legs are not firmly touching the floor
remedies: Push and pull on the back right and then back left of your washer to check if it is level.
If the washer is uneven, adjust the rubber leveling legs so they are all firmly touching the floor.
Your installer should correct this problem.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "All rubber leveling legs are not firmly touching the floor"

causes.label: Unbalanced load
remedies: Open door and manually redistribute load.
To check machine, run rinse and spin with no load.
If normal, unbalance was caused by load.

remedies: Check house circuit breakers/fuses.

remedies: First time the washer is plugged in, automatic checks occur.

symptoms.symptom: Water does not enter washer or enters slowly

causes.label: Automatic self system checks
remedies: After START is pressed, the washer does several system checks.
Water will flow several seconds after START is pressed.

causes.label: Water supply is turned off
remedies: Turn on both hot and cold faucets fully.

causes.label: Water valve screens are stopped up
remedies: Turn off the water source and remove the water connection hoses from the upper back of the washer.
Use a brush or toothpick to clean the screens in the machine.
Reconnect the hoses and turn the water back on.

causes.label: Improper sorting
remedies: Avoid mixing heavy items (like work clothes) with light items (like blouses).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 22: "Improper sorting"

causes.label: Overloading
remedies: Load your washer so clothes have enough room to move freely.

causes.label: Incorrect wash cycle
remedies: Match Cycle selection to the type of fabric you are washing (especially for easy care loads).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 22: "Incorrect wash cycle"

causes.label: Repeated washing in water that is too hot
remedies: Wash in warm or cold water.

causes.label: Not enough detergent
remedies: Use correct amount of detergent.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 22: "Not enough detergent"

causes.label: Not using HE (high efficiency) detergent
remedies: Use HE detergent.

causes.label: Hard water
remedies: Use hottest water safe for fabric.
Use a water conditioner like Calgon brand or install a water softener.

causes.label: Dye transfer
remedies: Sort clothes by color.
If fabric label states wash separately, unstable dyes may be indicated.

causes.label: Incorrect use of fabric softener
remedies: Check fabric softener package for instructions and follow directions for using dispenser.

causes.label: Dye transfer
remedies: Sort whites or lightly colored items from dark colors.
Promptly remove wash load from washer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 22: "Dye transfer"

causes.evidence: GE manual, page 22: "Water supply is improperly connected"
